info.name: Railway System - G4 Payment, Cancellation & Refund
info.description:
Group 4 (Payment, Cancellation & Refund) test collection for the National Railway Reservation & Management System. Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner.

Requirements: database built and seeded (db/ scripts), backend running on localhost:8080 with app.auth.dev-mode=true, app.auth.require-login-otp=false, app.auth.require-payment-otp=true and app.payment.mode=MOCK. Set the paymentMode collection variable to RAZORPAY only when the backend runs in Razorpay test mode.

Flow: login, search run, create booking (Asha, passengers 1 and 2), fare quote, payment OTP, wrong-OTP check, create payment order, mock-confirm, payment history, cancellation preview, cancel, refunds, then the admin fare, concession and audit endpoints. Negative cases check the error code: OTP_INVALID, PAYMENT_NOT_ALLOWED, ALREADY_CANCELLED, NOT_OWNER and 403 FORBIDDEN.
